settings.checks.label: Sessions' checks
settings.checks.why: What a driven session here may run of the repository's checks. Light keeps whole suites out of its sessions, so a session ends when its work does, not at its timeout.
settings.checks.says.today: Its sessions run their checks as they did: where it has heavy gates, each runs them once, at its end, through `run-heavy`.
settings.checks.says.light: Its sessions run its light gates and the checks their change reaches, filtered: a test class, a test file, a census. Its heavy gates run in its verification, never in a session.
settings.checks.says.heavy-at-end: Its sessions run the checks their change reaches while they work, and its heavy gates once, at their end, through `run-heavy`.
settings.checks.gatesNoLight: Light gates: none declared. Heavy gates: {{heavy}}.
settings.checks.noneHeavy: {{repository}} marks no heavy gate, so its sessions may run every gate.
settings.checks.harness: Where a session's agent takes Daoris's rules, the agent refuses each heavy gate's command too; an agent that takes none is told the heavy gates, and run-heavy refuses its tree, never its shell.
settings.checks.unverified: Daoris does not run the heavy gates after a landing yet: until a verification does, they run only where you run them.
settings.checks.saved.light: {{name}}’s sessions now run light checks: its heavy gates are left to its verification.
settings.checks.saved.heavy-at-end: {{name}}’s sessions now run its heavy gates once, at their end.
settings.checks.cleared: {{name}}’s sessions run their checks as they did.
